item.title: Rock the Ryman Returns With Wynonna, YOLA & More: See the Lineup So Far
item.description:
[Intro music plays, followed by the host]
Host: "Hey there, music lovers! Welcome to our podcast. Today, we're excited to share some news about an upcoming event that's going to get you rocking. Get ready for Rock the Ryman, a concert celebrating the intersection of rock & roll and country music, happening on September 1st at the historic Ryman Auditorium in Nashville.
[Soft music transitions in the background]
Host: "This event is all about honoring the legacy of Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees who have performed on the Ryman stage. And, we've got an amazing lineup of artists, including Wynonna, YOLA, Devon Allman, and Sam Bush, just to name a few. Each performer will be playing songs by Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees who have inspired their careers.
[Music transitions to a brief clip of a rock & roll song]
Host: "The event is hosted by the one and only John Oates, a 2014 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductee himself. And, it's sponsored by Gibson, the iconic American instrument brand, and their philanthropic division, Gibson Gives.
[Soft music continues]
Host: "This concert is part of a long-term collaboration between the Ryman Auditorium and the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, which includes a permanent exhibit on the Ryman daytime tour featuring memorabilia and stories from Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees.
[Music transitions to a brief clip of a country song]
Host: "Tickets for Rock the Ryman go on sale to the general public on July 31st at 10 a.m. CT. And, the best part? Proceeds from the event will help preserve the history of rock & roll and support education initiatives at the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame and Ryman Auditorium.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "So, mark your calendars for September 1st and get ready to rock out at the Ryman Auditorium. For more information, visit ryman.com. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode!"
